Convening map

Where this fits in the convening agenda

Quick readMore contextTechnical detailSpeaker notes

Use the agenda as a conversation map: barriers, commercialization, capitalization, partnerships, and the four Roadmap tracks. These are suggested connections for my examples.

Agenda itemWhat I bring
Day 1 dialogue: the most consequential gapsThe gap between eligibility and entry for independent contributors; the gap between prototype and maintained, validated software.
Session 1: CommercializationA proposed supported kernel library: technical qualification and customer discovery are separate milestones.
Session 2: CapitalizationSmall, staged awards for qualification, replication, and packaging; evaluate repeated support by resolved uncertainty.
Session 3: Scaling through partnershipsCommunity-to-research matching (FAC case); technical assistance network through existing structures.
Track A: BarriersInvestigate barriers faced by people without institutional support.
Track B: Best practicesPreregistered gates, retained failures, visible corrections; open-source stewardship.
Track C: Infrastructure for the under-resourcedPortal with accountable handoff; storage with stewardship; assistance network.
Track D: Funding pipelineRecords that let funders see progress beyond pass/fail; staged support tied to explicit qualification milestones.
